map.GN=40、距离 10m（ISO100）：可用光圈 f = GN/d = 40÷: GN=40, distance 10m (ISO100): usable aperture f = GN/d = 40/10 = f/4; at 5m then f/8, closer needs smaller aperture to avoid overexposure.
map.ISO 从 100 升到 400：修正系数 = √(400/100) = 2，等: ISO from 100 to 400: correction factor = sqrt(400/100) = 2, equivalent GN = 80, same distance usable f/8.
map.，GN = 光圈 f × 距离 m（ISO100）；越大闪光越强，是选灯与算曝光: , GN = aperture f x distance m (ISO100); larger means stronger flash, core to choosing lights and computing exposure.
map.影响，GN 随 √(ISO/100) 增；高 ISO 等效 GN 增大，同距可用: Yes, GN grows with sqrt(ISO/100); high ISO raises equivalent GN, same distance allows smaller aperture.
